name: Erin-Kate Heap
body: When I was a young girl Gunna would have me come over to be a helper with Paul and eventually Anika. Paul was loved and raised by two amazing empathetic, artsy, musical, kind and unconventional parents. Paul s life is a reflection of all the best parts of Gunna and Michael s magic and love and experience they provided. I will forever be grateful for all the moments you would just pop up out of nowhere on your bike. With the big smile on your face. God Bless you and your family Paul.
